summary: In the ABFAB architecture, this standards-track RFC describes using SAML with RADIUS. It defines two RADIUS attributes, a SAML binding, a name identifier format, two profiles and two confirmation methods, so SAML assertions and protocol messages can be carried inside RADIUS.

eli5.summary: SAML is a note vouching for who you are. This lets that note travel inside RADIUS, a system already used to check logins.
